Then D_{A∪B}(a) = D_A(a)·Z_B + Z_A·D0_B, and for every b ∈ B, D0_B = D_B(b) + 2·c_b^B ≥ D_B(b) coefficientwise, hence D_{A∪B}(a) ≥ D_A(a)·Z_B + Z_A·D_B(b). The naive form D_{A∪B}(a) = D_A(a)·Z_B is FALSE (smallest witness A = B = K_1: left (0, 2, 2), right 0).

D0_B IS the (DL) slack family of B: the reduction presupposes nothing about (DL) and proves nothing about it — it converts (DL)-on-components plus single-root nonnegativity into single-root nonnegativity on the union.
